question: Should OpenClaw add bundled modular-dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets now, and what disclosure boundary should govern logs, stdout/stderr, command text, retention, and export?
rationale: The feature is aligned with dashboard ergonomics, but it introduces a new operator-visible surface for sensitive logs and command output before the dashboard substrate and stream/command binding contracts are settled.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
options.body: Keep this issue open, finish or reject the dashboard substrate and approve the stream/command data-source model before implementing the widgets.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Read-Only Sources
options.body: Allow a smaller follow-up limited to existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded command-output summaries, with no new command execution or generic command binding.

options.title: Defer Bundled Widgets
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context until maintainers sponsor dashboard builtins or an external plugin path proves the capability safely.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, finish or reject the dashboard substrate and approve the stream/command data-source model before implementing the widgets.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest merged-history signal is the Logbook Control UI plugin-tab precedent that this dashboard work builds on.
